_about: Art slots of the remake UI (docs/remake/UI.md). size = delivery size in px; aspect is fixed, the UI scales. Style for every slot: 1980s retro-futurist sci-fi paperback / box-art: airbrush, warm amber key light, deep blue space, soft glow. transparent = with alpha. variants = extra slots <id>.<variant> (calm = the base id). Placeholders are under docs/modern/assets/. Finished art: tools/remake_art.py pick/export writes remake_art/picked/<id>.png (master) and web/remake/art/<id>.webp + <id>.s.webp (phone size) + manifest.json (docs/remake/UI.md section 6); the UI uses it when the id is in the manifest.
style: 1980s retro-futurist sci-fi paperback / box-art: airbrush, warm amber key light, deep blue space, soft glow
